'''Jubei''' (Japanese: '''ジュウベエ''' ''Jūbei'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[HS12|Training Daze]]''. 

He was a red team member and [[Jessie]]'s twelfth partner (tenth in the dub). He shared a {{p|Mankey}} with her as well, until they failed a robbing test. This resulted in him getting a poor grade.
